label: A12B_cP13_200_j_b-001
title: Theoretical Cubic LiH$_{12}$ Structure
comments: (Verma, 2025) published a large number of predictions of possible superconducting Li-H compounds at 250 using the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof functional with VASP. They identified this structure as the best candidate for finding high-temperature superconductivity, with a transition temperature $T_{c}$ above 300K.
